title: BlueBlocks: API Rate Limiting & Security Hardening
description:
Implement API rate limiting and security hardening measures.

## Security Gaps Identified

### Rate Limiting (Critical)
- No rate limiting on API endpoints
- Risk of DDoS attacks
- Risk of brute force attacks

### Implementation Requirements
- Per-IP rate limiting
- Per-user rate limiting (authenticated)
- Endpoint-specific limits
- Graduated response (429 → temp ban → permanent)

### Recommended Limits
| Endpoint Type | Rate Limit |
|---------------|------------|
| Public APIs | 60/min |
| Authenticated | 300/min |
| Faucet | 1/5min |
| Contract Deploy | 10/hour |
| Admin APIs | 30/min |

### Additional Security Measures
- Request signing for sensitive operations
- IP allowlisting for admin APIs
- Anomaly detection integration
- CAPTCHA for public endpoints
